run_commons_harvest_closed: run the commons_harvest closed level human player with WASD movement and zapper controls
run_commons_harvest_open: run the commons_harvest open level human player with configurable observation rendering
run_commons_harvest_partnership: run the commons_harvest partnership level human player with multi-agent controls
run_verbose_debug: run the commons_harvest player in verbose mode to print debug information during gameplay
run_print_events: run the commons_harvest player with event printing enabled to log gameplay events
